content.title: China Jockeys for Better Access to US Deals
content.description: Beijing is pushing the Trump administration to roll back national-security restrictions on Chinese deals in the US, using the prospect of a massive investment package as leverage. Baird Tech Strategist Ted Mortonson discusses the breaking news in the context of reports that AI processors from Huawei contain parts from TSMC, Samsung, and SK Hynix. Mortonson speaks with Caroline Hyde and Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech."
